extraction.payment_terms: 20% upon execution ($130,000), 30% upon Phase 1 completion ($195,000), 30% upon Phase 2 completion ($195,000), 20% upon final acceptance ($130,000). Net 30. Late payments at 1.5%/month.
key_clauses: Confidentiality — 5-year obligation covering technical data, trade secrets, customer lists, financial information
Intellectual Property — Pre-existing IP stays with owner; Deliverables owned by Client upon full payment; Provider retains tools/frameworks/methodologies
Indemnification — Mutual; Provider for negligence/misconduct, Client for misuse of Deliverables
Limitation of Liability — Capped at $650,000 (total contract value); no consequential damages except for gross negligence/willful misconduct
Data Protection — GLBA, CCPA compliance; appropriate technical and organizational measures required
termination_conditions: Convenience termination by either Party with 60 days' written notice
Immediate termination for material breach with 30 days' cure period
Immediate termination by Client if Provider undergoes change of control, bankruptcy, or insolvency
Work-in-progress and Deliverables due within 15 business days of termination

obligations.obligation: Assign dedicated project manager and technical lead
Provide weekly status reports and monthly executive summaries
All personnel must pass background checks
Comply with Client's information security policies
Provide timely access to systems, environments, and personnel
Designate a project sponsor and technical point of contact
Review and provide feedback on deliverables within 10 business days
Provide test data and test environments
Execute change orders for scope modifications

extraction.governing_law: State of Illinois; binding arbitration in Chicago, Illinois

clauses.notes: Standard 5-year term; covers appropriate categories; mutual obligation
Provider retains pre-existing tools and methodologies — Client should ensure Deliverables can function independently without Provider's proprietary tools
Mutual and balanced; Provider covers negligence, Client covers misuse
Cap at total contract value ($650K) is standard. Carve-out for gross negligence/willful misconduct is favorable to Client
GLBA and CCPA referenced but no specific technical standards (e.g., encryption requirements, SOC 2) are mandated. Given banking context, stronger technical controls should be specified
60-day notice period is reasonable and mutual
